description: Admin-tier module access (user & role administration). Deprecated: implies viewing members, managing grants and engine-wide secrets (the last honoured only for platform staff and in House).
Analyst-tier module access (ML / research actions). Deprecated: implies running platform research (honoured only for platform staff and in House).
EA data-ingestion path (tick/candle/snapshot/execution reports). Deprecated: implies the EA execution path (orders.ingest).

Operator-tier module access (engine config, risk, account management). Deprecated: implies the risk, account, kill-switch, flatten and decision-trail keys, and the platform operations keys (honoured only for platform staff and in House).
Trader-tier module access (order/signal actions). Deprecated: implies placing, changing and cancelling orders and managing positions.
Baseline read-only access to dashboards, lists and detail pages. Deprecated: give the specific read keys instead.
Create roles and assign/update their permissions. Changes need a fresh MFA sign-in.
Create and manage admin users and their role assignments.

Set up where the organisation's alerts go — its Telegram bot and chat, e-mail recipients and webhook (URL and signing secret) — and send test alerts. Secrets are write-only. Changes need a fresh MFA sign-in.
Read, export and verify the audit log (sign-ins, access changes, configuration and trading controls).
Read the decision trail: why signals, orders, strategies and configuration changed.
Record entries in the decision trail.
Machine path: a trade-server gateway (daemon credential) posts its client trades to a feed that lists it.
Register and change the organisation's external client-trade feeds (MT5 trade servers) and which gateway identities may post them.

View the dealing desk: client-flow analytics, markouts, toxicity, latency-arbitrage and scalping profiles, advisory A/B-book suggestions, liquidity-provider analytics and alerts (needs the broker module in the organisation's plan).
Read and change the organisation's own configuration: values for all of its accounts, or — granted on an account or account group — for those accounts. Risk-loosening values also need risk.loosen.
See and engage kill switches: the organisation's, a trading account's or a strategy's (the global one is the platform operator's).
Release an engaged kill switch. Needs a fresh MFA sign-in and, where two-person rules apply, a second person's approval.
Toggle paper/live trading mode and backfill paper executions.
Download the organisation's compliance export for a period — its audit log, order lifecycle and approvals as JSON or CSV with a SHA-256 hash and signature — and check a copy against the register.
Read best-execution evidence reports (slippage against the arrival mid, spread paid, fill latency, markouts, broker comparison) and download them as CSV or PDF.

Read performance statements (time-weighted return, drawdown, Sharpe/Sortino, monthly returns) and download them as CSV or PDF — granted on an account or account group, for those accounts only (the Investor role).

Set the organisation's four-eyes policies: which actions need how many approvers, with which roles, above which amount. Loosening a policy needs a reason and, when one is set, the approvers of the policy-change policy. Changes need a fresh MFA sign-in.
Run access reviews and revoke grants that are no longer used; receives the monthly access-review notice.
Approve or reject two-person requests (the approver must also hold the action's own permission and cannot approve their own request).
Grant and revoke roles at organisation, account-group, account or strategy scope; manage teams and account groups. Only what you hold yourself can be granted. Changes need a fresh MFA sign-in.
Invite people to the organisation and revoke pending invitations.
View the organisation's members, invitations, teams, account groups and role grants.
Change the organisation's security policy: required MFA, session lifetimes, IP allow-list. Changes need a fresh MFA sign-in.
View and end other members' sign-in sessions.
Configure single sign-on for the organisation and issue SCIM provisioning tokens. Changes need a fresh MFA sign-in.
Create personal access tokens (limited to the permissions you hold). Needs a fresh MFA sign-in.
Cancel a running or pending LLM analysis backtest run.
Launch a new LLM analysis backtest run (cost-bearing — calls the LLM with historical snapshots).
View LLM analysis backtest runs and per-point outcomes.
Store and remove the organisation's own LLM provider API keys (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek). Keys are write-only. Changes need a fresh MFA sign-in.
See the organisation's LLM usage and spend per day, provider and model, its LLM budget and which provider it runs on.
Run backtests / walk-forward / evaluation jobs.
View ML models, training runs and evaluations.
Roll back / promote ML model versions.
Queue ML training and hyperparameter searches.
Ingest ticks/candles/snapshots (EA data path).
View market data, prices and analyses.
Approve a signal-generated order for placement.
Cancel or delete a working order.
Batch-cancel multiple orders.
Place new orders.
EA execution path: orders from signals, execution reports, broker ids, abandoned orders and position observations.
Modify working orders (SL/TP/price, entry moves).
View orders and order history (and the positions they opened).
Platform staff: create, list, suspend and reactivate organisations (tenants), and manage any organisation's members. Also requires acting in House or being a super admin.
See the organisation's metered usage (connected terminals, active users, modules, licensed feeds), its estimated charges for the month and its finalised invoices (and download them).
Change the organisation's console look: display name, primary colour, logo and favicon.
See the organisation's console look (name, colour, logo, favicon) — the console applies it after sign-in.

Close the organisation: sign-in and trading stop at once, its terminals are disconnected and its data is deleted after a 30-day grace period. Needs a fresh MFA sign-in and, when the organisation has more than one Owner, a second Owner's approval.
Export everything the organisation owns (its records, its private strategies and its audit trail; secrets left out) as a download available for 7 days. Needs a fresh MFA sign-in.
Add, remove, suspend and reactivate members of the organisation you are acting in.
See the organisation's plan — what it allows — and how much of it is in use.
Platform staff: edit and publish plan price books, draft every organisation's monthly invoice from metering, review, finalise or void invoices and hand them to the payment provider.
Platform staff: change platform market and reference data — currency pairs, economic events, the candle source and candle repairs, regime, microstructure, sentiment and news-intelligence backfills.
Platform staff: approve another staff member's time-limited access to an organisation's data. Needs a fresh MFA sign-in.
Platform staff: request time-limited access (at most 4 hours) to an organisation's data; another staff member approves it.

Platform staff: change engine-wide settings and controls every organisation shares — engine configuration, LLM, spot sweep, spread-reactive, news-intelligence, auto-tune, viability gates, promotion and trading-window policy, paper and martingale mode, alert channels. House operators hold it while acting in House.
Platform staff: change engine-wide settings that carry secrets (LLM provider API keys, secret configuration values).
Platform staff: see every organisation's EA terminals — state, version, last heartbeat, credential — and engaged kill switches (read-only; each view is audited).
Platform staff: view the console as another user (read-only unless an approved elevation allows changes; recorded in that organisation's audit log). Needs a fresh MFA sign-in.
Platform staff: operate platform machinery — MT5 hosts and terminals, supervisor daemons, the event-bus dead-letter queue.
Platform staff: create and edit plans (limits and features) and move organisations between plans.
Platform staff: steer platform research — activate and roll back ML models, CompositeML overrides, experiments, strategy generation, LLM strategy proposals, the algo-engineer.
Platform staff: queue platform research — ML training and hyperparameter searches, shadow evaluations.
Platform staff: review a closed organisation's deletion plan (a dry run) and confirm the permanent deletion of its data once its grace period is over. Needs a fresh MFA sign-in.
Platform staff: see any organisation's usage against its plan and download the monthly usage export for invoicing.
Flatten an EA instance's account, or the whole fleet (closes every position and cancels every order).
Close positions, change their stop-loss/take-profit and trailing stops, and scale them.

Fork, update and archive prompt-template rows. Editor-tier permission — non-cost-of-error: edits only touch drafts (active and archived rows are immutable) so the live LLM behaviour cannot change via this key alone.
Promote a draft prompt-template row to active. Cost-of-error — when UseDbBackedPromptTemplate is on the promoted row IS the live spot-analysis SystemPrompt on the next call. Gate tightly.
View DB-backed LLM SystemPrompt templates — listing, detail, active resolution, diff.
Create and version prop programs, manage traders, enrol accounts, withdraw and advance enrolments, and prepare payout statements.
Approve or reject prepared payout statements (never one you prepared yourself while the platform requires a second person). Statements move no money. Needs a fresh MFA sign-in.
See the organisation's prop programs, traders, enrolments, every trader's dashboard, the live breach feed, the leaderboard and payout statements (and export them).
See your own prop challenge dashboard: the enrolments of the trading account you signed in with, or of the trader linked to your user.

Make a risk-loosening change (a lower floor, a higher cap, a gate to advisory). Needs a fresh MFA sign-in and, where two-person rules apply, a second person's approval; the change then waits out the cooling-off period.
Create/update/delete risk profiles and see and rebase drawdown recovery.
View risk profiles and exposure.
Edit strategy parameters and settings.
Pause/activate/promote/retire strategies.
View strategies and their settings.
Approve a pending trade signal.
View generated trade signals.
Reject a pending trade signal.
Change a trading account's broker password or rotate its EA API key. Needs a fresh MFA sign-in.
Create, edit, activate, delete trading accounts and assign their risk profiles.
View trading accounts.
